title: 05｜用户首 token 与兜底体验
description: 业务首token：用户提交到第一个token实际显示，包含首发等待和兜底全过程。按所选型号统计，缺报不补0，无AI自动调参。

list.name: model
list.label: 型号
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT requested_model_id AS __text,requested_model_id AS __value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected ORDER BY 1

options.content:
**用户总首 token 耗时 = 用户提交 → 第一个 token 在界面实际显示**，包含等待首发、切换兜底及最终显示的全部时间。单位为秒。

默认最近24小时；可选全部型号或筛选单个型号。P50/P90/P95只计算前台实际看到首token的样本，**必须同时看超时率、可判定占比和请求量**。兜底触发率包含触发后仍失败的轮次；超时率分母为前台「已看到＋超时」。缺报、后台和其他未观测不算成功。只列有有效请求的型号；`—` 表示没有足够的该项样本，绝不代表0。无AI自动调参。

panels.title: 每型号业务总览
panels.description: 按用户所选型号分组。一轮只算一次请求；排除余额/权益拒绝。前台已知结果超时率=前台超时/(前台已看到+前台超时)，缺报不进入该分母；回报覆盖率与前台可判定占比用于判断可靠性。后台成功不进入耗时分位。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT requested_model_id AS "型号", count(*) AS "请求量",
 percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS "用户总首 token P90",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE fallback_started)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "兜底触发率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out' AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "前台已知结果超时率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome<>'missing')/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "回报覆盖率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "前台可判定占比",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "前台已看到样本",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out' AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "前台超时样本",
 percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS "用户总首 token P50",
 percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS "用户总首 token P95",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE delivery_role='fallback' AND client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "已看到样本中兜底占比",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='missing') AS "缺报请求",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='not_observed') AS "其他未观测请求"
FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY requested_model_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC,requested_model_id

panels.title: 用户总首 token P90 · 各型号
panels.description: 每5分钟前台实际看到首token的P90。它已经包括首发等待和兜底，不由两段P90相加。没有报告或未显示时不补技术耗时。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), requested_model_id AS metric, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 兜底触发率 · 各型号
panels.description: 已触发兜底的请求/全部有效请求，包含触发后仍超时或失败的请求；不是只看成功兜底。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), requested_model_id AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE fallback_started)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 前台已知结果超时率 · 各型号
panels.description: 前台超时/(前台已看到+前台超时)。其他错误/取消/后台/缺报单独保留；低覆盖时不能据此宣称达到1%。监控目标取各时间段记录的人工目标快照。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), requested_model_id AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out' AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), '监控目标' AS metric, 100.0*max(timeout_rate_target) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 客户端回报覆盖率 · 各型号
panels.description: 收到任意客户端最终报告的请求/全部有效请求。已报告的取消、错误也计覆盖，不等于首token已看到；可判定占比与成功/超时样本数见总览。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), requested_model_id AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome<>'missing')/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 人工调整对照 · 同型号按当轮等待配置分组
panels.description: 按型号、配置版本、首发等待、总上限、兜底型号分组；型号总体150门槛不代替各参数组样本量。只比较同一型号，不平均各组P90或百分比。

targets.rawSql: SELECT j->>'model_id' AS "型号",(j->>'model_requests')::int AS "型号总请求",(j->>'sample_eligible')::boolean AS "型号达到150样本",(j->>'requests')::int AS "本组请求",(j->>'primary_timeout_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "首发等待",(j->>'first_token_deadline_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "总等待上限",j->>'fallback_model_id' AS "兜底型号",(j->>'user_first_token_p90_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "用户总首 token P90",100*(j->>'fallback_start_rate')::numeric AS "兜底触发率",100*(j->>'foreground_timeout_rate_observed')::numeric AS "前台已知结果超时率",100*(j->>'client_report_coverage')::numeric AS "回报覆盖率",(j->>'catalog_version')::int AS "配置版本" FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_report($__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) j WHERE '__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR j->>'model_id' IN (${model:sqlstring}) ORDER BY j->>'model_id',(j->>'catalog_version')::int,(j->>'primary_timeout_ms')::int
